title: Engineering Practices & Technical Leadership
intro: Engineering practices interview questions test whether you operate as a senior engineer outside the IDE — running effective code reviews, writing Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), managing technical debt strategically, building knowledge-sharing culture, mentoring junior engineers, leading cross-team initiatives, and the technical-leadership questions that come up at staff and principal level ("how would you approach the first 90 days on a team with high tech debt?"). Pair this with the Behavioral page for the full senior-interview narrative surface.
